Q1533936.description: sex or gender identity of human or animal. For human: male, female, non-binary, intersex, transgender female, transgender male, agender, etc. For animal: male organism, female organism. Groups of same gender use subclass of (P279)

Q1533936.label: country of citizenship
Q1533936.description: the object is a country that recognizes the subject as its citizen

Q1533936.label: instance of
Q1533936.description: that class of which this subject is a particular example and member; different from P279 (subclass of); for example: K2 is an instance of mountain; volcano is a subclass of mountain (and an instance of volcanic landform)

Q1533936.label: participant in
Q1533936.description: event in which a person or organization was/is a participant; inverse of P710 or P1923

Q1533936.label: sports discipline competed in
Q1533936.description: discipline an athlete competed in within a sport

Q1533936.label: Commons category
Q1533936.description: name of the Wikimedia Commons category containing files related to this item (without the prefix "Category:")

Q1533936.label: date of birth
Q1533936.description: date on which the subject was born

Q1533936.label: date of death
Q1533936.description: date on which the subject died

Q1533936.label: sport
Q1533936.description: sport that the subject participates or participated in or is associated with

Q1533936.label: family name
Q1533936.description: part of full name of person

Q1533936.label: given name
Q1533936.description: first name or another given name of this person; values used with the property should not link disambiguations nor family names
